profile.headline: Turning coffee into solutions
profile.summary: I’m a full-stack developer who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution. I enjoy working on challenging problems, translating high-level goals into practical solutions, and helping teams level up through thoughtful architecture and guidance. When I’m not coding, I’m exploring new frameworks, tinkering with side projects, or finding better ways to make software a little less painful.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I build and maintain AI-powered systems that remove manual work from the software delivery process, with a focus on automating ticket triage, code review, and failure investigation. 

- Connect AI agents to the tools engineers are already using so agents can read context and take action
- Build back-end services for logging and monitoring AI work
- Find why automations fail, fix the processes, review the outcomes, and continuously improve with new frontier strategies and personal experimentation
- Set quality gates, tests, and draft system documentation so others can trust the output of AI work
- Work closely with engineering teams and product managers to refine AI processes and and promote best practices across the organization
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Large Language Models (LLM) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Claude Code · OpenAI Codex · Claude Agent SDK · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
One of the earliest engineers at PayHOA, a SaaS platform serving thousands of homeowner associations. Built 16+ foundational systems from scratch — including billing, payments, financial reporting, vendor management, and violations tracking — then led the engineering organization through rapid growth.

Key contributions:

- Architected full Stripe Billing integration (subscriptions, invoicing, credit management, idempotent payment processing)
- Led a major accounting system overhaul with ledger auditing and 10x transaction query performance improvements
- Built core platform features end-to-end: vendor/bill pay, Plaid bank integrations, bank reconciliation, PDF generation framework, and automated late fee processing
- Grew the engineering team from 2 to 10 developers with mentorship, code review, and standardized testing practices
- Supported 60% YoY growth over 5 consecutive years
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Angular · PHP · Stripe (Software) · Financial Accounting · IT Leadership

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Built web and mobile applications for clients ranging from major brands to independent products. Work spanned progressive web apps, offline-first mobile apps deployed to the iOS App Store, and real-time digital signage for venue displays. Typically served as lead or sole developer on small teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Cordova · PHP · Direct Sales · Technical Support · Software Project Management · Mobile Applications

positions.title: Developer II
positions.description:
Maintained and modernized data systems that normalize, aggregate, and produce reports on vehicle registration data sourced from 23 states, giving car dealerships a competitive edge in their local markets.

Much of the core codebase was written in Visual FoxPro — a language Microsoft discontinued in 2007. I dove in, became proficient in FoxPro, and systematically translated legacy code dating back to the late 1980s into modern, maintainable systems. Also automated the report production pipeline with Jenkins, cutting delivery times from weeks to same-day.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Reporting · Windows Server · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Core

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer for AIR, a CakePHP based web application for case management and device status monitoring for parole officers.
positions.insights: Skills: CakePHP · PHP · GPS Devices · Real-time Monitoring

positions.description: Developer for CTG-Kentucky, a database for tracking research and coalition organization's activity across the state implemented in CakePHP.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description: I started as an intern writing front end jquery for Wordpress plugins, and moved into a more active development role converting existing company owned sites to CakePHP.
